thunder.prompt: A loud, dramatic thunder crack followed by a deep rolling rumble, like a dramatic reveal in a cartoon. No rain.

dig.prompt: A single short crunchy scoop of a shovel digging into soft dirt, cartoon video game sound effect.

break.prompt: A small block of packed earth and pebbles breaking apart, short crumbly crunch, video game sound effect.

clink.prompt: A loud, clear metallic clang of a steel shovel striking hard stone, bright ringing clink, video game sound effect.

drill.prompt: A short burst of a small electric power drill grinding into rock, video game sound effect.

bill.prompt: Picking up paper money: a quick crisp banknote rustle with a tiny happy chime, video game pickup sound.

gold.prompt: Collecting a gold nugget: bright sparkly ascending chime with a little coin jingle, video game pickup sound.

gem.prompt: Collecting a precious gem: magical crystal shimmer and sparkle, video game pickup sound.

jump.prompt: A cartoon jump: short springy whoosh, cute platformer video game sound effect.

hurt.prompt: A cartoon character gets hurt: short soft thud with a little bonk, video game damage sound, no voice.

buy.prompt: A successful purchase in a shop: cash register ding with a happy coin jingle, video game sound.

deny.prompt: Error, not enough money: short low double buzz, cute video game menu denial sound.

ui.prompt: A clear, crisp and clearly audible bubbly pop click of a game menu button, cute and bright.

bark.prompt: A small happy dachshund dog barking twice, short and cute.

bark3.prompt: A small dachshund dog doing an excited, playful double bark: arf arf.

bark5.prompt: A small dachshund dog barking three quick, excited little yaps.

surprise.prompt: A cartoon surprise sting: short quick rising ding, like an exclamation mark, video game sound effect.

gate.prompt: An old wooden garden gate made of wooden planks slowly creaking open on old hinges: a dry, hollow wooden creak, no metal sounds.

gateShut.prompt: A wooden gate closing with a solid thud and a metal latch click.

boom.prompt: A big cartoon explosion: punchy boom with a rumble and falling debris, video game sound effect.

magic.prompt: A magical transformation: shimmering chimes, sparkles and a whoosh, fantasy video game power-up sound.

squirt.prompt: A short squirt of a toy water pistol, quick spray of water.

laugh.prompt: A cartoon villain eagle laughing: a squawky, bird-like, mischievous cackle, theatrical and funny rather than scary.

peep.prompt: Small baby eagle chicks chirping peep peep, cartoon.

beam.prompt: A purple magic laser beam firing: sci-fi energy zap with crackle, video game sound effect.

flame.prompt: A burst of fire: big whoosh of a fireball blast, video game sound effect.

bossHit.prompt: A boss enemy gets hit: punchy cartoon impact bonk, video game sound effect, no words.
